name: zdi_reset_current_variant
description: zDi::ResetCurrentVariant resets the first material cycle to frame zero and restores the material's current texture entry to frameTable[0], leaving materials without a cycle unchanged.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Functional coverage checks direct material-cycle behavior and the zEffect activation path that depends on it.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja reconstruction and assembly for 0x484230 validate reading self->entries->material, checking material->cycle, setting cycle->currentFrame to 0.0, and copying cycle->frameTable[0] to material->currentTextureDirectoryEntry only when a cycle exists.

The native zDi smoke verifies currentFrame reset, texture entry reset to frameTable[0], and null-cycle no-op behavior. zeffect_init_smoke covers the effect activation path that calls ResetCurrentVariant.
